title: Private settlement. Shared confidence.
narration: Meet Core: private business settlement on NEAR, with evidence you choose to share. Built for business invoices, worker payments, and contractor payouts.

title: Distributed principal. Shared proof.
scope: PROTOCOL ARCHITECTURE · PUBLIC METADATA REMAINS VISIBLE
narration: Principal stays in independent vaults. A shared zero knowledge note authorizes a funded vault to pay, without naming the input note. A global nullifier prevents a second spend.

title: Start with a signed invoice
scope: CONTROLLED BROWSER DEMO · FIXTURE WALLET AND API
narration: The recipient creates a signed invoice. Checkout verifies the request, payment unit, merchant, and trusted group before a payer selects an encrypted note.

title: Generate the proof locally
scope: REAL LOCAL GROTH16 PROOF · FIXTURE CHAIN CONTEXT
narration: Here, the browser generates a real Groth sixteen proof using verified proving files. Note secrets and the note password stay local. Proof generation can also be cancelled.

title: Review before every signature
scope: CONTROLLED BROWSER DEMO · NO PUBLIC USDC TRANSFER
narration: Review the amount and the added fifteen basis point fee. The recipient receives the full principal. Storage and network gas are separate, and each required wallet call is reviewed individually.

title: Confirm from finalized observations
scope: FIXTURE FINALITY OBSERVATION · NOT A LIVE WALLET RECEIPT
narration: The payment view reconciles finalized observations. An uncertain response stays unresolved until checked, avoiding an automatic second payment. This browser walkthrough uses a test wallet and API fixtures.

title: Turn evidence into a cited draft
scope: SOURCE-BOUND OUTLINE DEMO · NO LIVE AI OR PROFESSIONAL APPROVAL
narration: Teams can prepare cited tax and procedure drafts from verified rule calculations and selected evidence. This example uses deterministic outline mode. Unsupported obligations remain visible for review.

title: Separate preparation from approval
narration: Submit an immutable revision for another authorized reviewer. The author cannot approve their own preparation. Changes require a new revision, and source or permission changes invalidate reliance.

title: Fourteen real testnet transactions
scope: RECORDED PUBLIC TESTNET EVIDENCE · NATIVE NEAR · CLI WALLET
narration: Separately, the native NEAR software wallet run recorded fourteen real public testnet transactions. Two deposits of point one NEAR reached keyless vaults, followed by successful payouts.

title: A real failure. The original destination.
scope: RECORDED PUBLIC TESTNET EVIDENCE · RETRYABLE TO COMPLETE
narration: A missing recipient caused an actual failed transfer. After activating that same recipient, recovery kept the original nullifier, vault, amount, and destination. The retry charged no second protocol fee.

title: A prototype with explicit boundaries
scope: PRIVACY DEPENDS ON PARTICIPATION AND METADATA
narration: The read only verifier rechecks receipts, signatures, code, keys, and historical balances. This does not establish effective anonymity. Browser wallet and USDC public testnet qualification, live hosting, and production review remain separate.

title: Inspect. Run. Verify.
narration: Explore the three repositories, follow the quick start, and verify the published transaction evidence. Core: private settlement, shared confidence.
